alternative_routes: A validated electronic-energy/state investigation can test the family response and a chosen explanation without a prescribed frozen-core matrix. Historical full-size PBE0/def2-SVP n2 logs support the feasibility of this route for selected objects, not overall V2 acceptance.

An independently justified electronic-structure analysis, including evidence of reconstruction or limits of a proposed account, is eligible for corresponding credit. Its evidence and scope must be adequate; no different method is certified solely by schema acceptance.
conditional_requirements: Correct complete composition and state for every claimed object.
Stationarity/search evidence for minimum/lowest-state claims; matched geometry and consistent energy components for the selected affinity definition.
Appropriate electronic evidence for electronic mechanisms; no universal analysis operation.
Coverage and uncertainty proportionate to the declared family-level inference.

enforcement_layers.host_schema: Official output_contract checks required report files, JSON structure, declared units/enums and conditional fields.
enforcement_layers.author_side_checker: work/check_v2.py alone checks resolved artifact IDs, file existence, SHA256 and selected arithmetic. These checks are not automatically installed in the host.
enforcement_layers.judge_review: Evidence sufficiency, actual chemistry, cross-record scientific comparability, method adequacy and scope require real artifact/judge review; not run or calibrated in this development.
enforcement_layers.runtime_pending: Host artifact integrity integration, reliable tool-event binding and access isolation require coordinator integration/verification.
